candidates.attributionBasis: The moderator explicitly addresses the question to Chris, and Chris gives an extended first-person defense of the Thomistic account.
candidates.loadBearingReason: The response addresses a central coherence objection concerning divine knowledge of changing contingent reality while preserving simplicity, immutability, and atemporality.

responseIntent.earlierTargetDescription: The question argues that extrinsic relational changes may suffice to make the simple God temporal.

candidates.contextSummary: Chris locates changing God-world relations in creatures and illustrates the asymmetry through dinosaurs and divine knowledge, claiming the world conforms to God's mind rather than conversely.
